description: probe-contract §Testing asks for an endpoint that flip-flops its ETag with no content change. Three checks against the same URL: "v1"->"v2", then "v2"->"v1", then a 200 that echoes the very If-None-Match we sent. The first two are indistinguishable, from inside a single check, from an endpoint that legitimately changed twice; they are Drift, and detecting the churn across them is the engine's anti-thrash job, not this probe's. The third IS statelessly detectable and is where the probe earns the etag-instability diagnostic. See README §The honest boundary.
